name: blackbox-web-recon
description: Authorized HTTP-only app behavior reconstruction with blind reviewers and fixed, independently checked scoring.

interface.longDescription: Assess HTTP-visible behavior using fresh blind reviewers, a fixed scoring inventory, counts-only feedback, and explicit authorization boundaries. Requires an owner-controlled test environment and host-provided tools.
defaultPrompt: Use Black-box Web Recon to plan a scoped self-audit of my own local test app.
Use Black-box Web Recon to compare sanitized blind findings against a fixed rule inventory.
